source_quote: I was drafted by the San Francisco Warriors and I was delighted to have an opportunity to earn $18,000 a year
notes: Barry's testimony, Senate Antitrust Subcommittee hearing on S. 2373 (professional basketball), 21 Sep 1971. APBR agrees: '14Jun65 1965-66 SFW 1 year, $18,000'.

source_quote: Barry played professional basketball for the Warriors during the 1966-1967 season and was paid the full compensation of $75,000 provided for by the contract
notes: Lemat Corp. v. Barry, 275 Cal.App.2d 671 (1969), statement of facts, reprinted in the 1971 Senate hearing record (OCR '.$75,000'). Warriors' option tender for 1967-68 was also '$75,000 a year'. Conflicts: APBR '1966 1966-67 SFW 1 year, $45,000'; Encyclopedia.com: 'had been making $30,000 a year as a Warrior'.

basis: paid while barred from playing (allegation in court filing)
source_quote: Plaintiffs paid said Rick Barry $75,000 not to play basketball for the San Francisco Warriors during the 1967-1968 basketball season
notes: NBA's Answer and Counterclaim, ABA v. NBA, Civil No. 51055 (N.D. Cal.), 17 Apr 1969, para. 6.4, reprinted in House Judiciary hearing record 'The antitrust laws and organized professional team sports' (1972). Barry sat out 1967-68 under court injunction (see spans). It is the NBA's allegation, not an Oaks document.
